name: Tape Orchestra
description: Orchestral sections played from a strip of worn tape under every key: strings, cellos, flutes, horns, reeds and a choir that wobble, lurch, hiss and run out.

params.name: Tape
params.description: Which recording is on the tapes: a small violin section, cellos, flutes, French horns, a clarinet and oboe blend, or a mixed choir on ah. Notes already sounding cross over to the new tape.

params.name: Age
params.description: How worn the tapes and the machine are. More gives every key a deeper wobble of its own, a flatter lurch as the tape is gripped, keys that sit a little out of tune and level with each other, a narrower and grittier sound and, near the top, dropouts.

params.name: Hiss
params.description: Tape hiss under the notes. It is only there while keys sound and grows as more of them are held.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Tilts the playback from dark and muffled, through the plain tape in the middle, to open and airy.

params.name: Speed
params.description: Half runs the tapes at half speed: everything sounds an octave lower and darker, with slower attacks, slower vibrato and twice the tape length. Switching while notes sound slows the tape down or brings it back up.

params.name: Length
params.description: How much tape each key has. A held note fades out over its last half second when the tape runs out and has to be struck again. Fully up, the tape never ends.

params.name: Attack
params.description: Fades each note in, on top of the start that is recorded on the tape. Short lets the bow scrape or breath through; long is a swell.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade out after the key is let go.

params.name: Section
params.description: How different the players on each tape are. At zero they play as one; higher they drift apart in tuning, come in at slightly different moments and swell on their own, like a looser section.

params.name: Vibrato
params.description: How much vibrato the players use. Each one starts it a little after the note begins and at a rate of their own.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How far the players of each key sit apart between left and right. At zero the instrument is mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.
